title: Bodycam Video Shows DC Cops Stop Robbery Attack
description:
** (Disclaimer: This video content is intended for educational and informational purposes only) **
This video is footage recorded by an MPD officer's Body Worn Camera showing the MPD response to an Assault with Intent to Rob (Knife) incident which occurred in the 1900 block of Martin Luther King, Jr. Avenue, SE, on Wednesday, March 23, 2016 at approximately 9:43 AM. The identities of the individuals involved have been redacted.
